root_causes.title: Missing Infigraph Runtime Integration
root_causes.description: The knowledgebase lacks a wrapper to invoke the Infigraph CLI and report analysis capabilities.
root_causes.solution_summary: Create a new Python module in scripts/analysis to act as a wrapper for the Infigraph CLI, including reproducible version pinning and robust capability status reporting.

tasks.title: Add reproducible Infigraph runtime and capability contract
